US Suspends Green Card Filings for Indian IT Firms

The United States has suspended green card filings for Indian IT companies Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Wipro, and HCL. This action is expected to have a negative impact on Indian IT workers seeking permanent residency in the US. The suspension affects the process through which these companies have been filing for green cards on behalf of their employees.
